description: the same permissions as `default`, for the origins only a developer loads: the dev server on localhost:3000 and any Vercel preview deployment reached through MIXTURE_DESKTOP_URL. `https://*.vercel.app` matches every preview of every Vercel account, so this capability is never part of a released build: .github/workflows/release.yml overrides app.security.capabilities with `["default"]`, and a build that does not name a capability set enables every file in this directory.
